title: Multi-file workspace: Orders and Customers
prompt: Split a small microservice landscape across files using `!include`: a root workspace file that just wires subsystems together, plus one file per subsystem. A Customer (person) places orders via an Orders system; the Orders system looks up customer details from a Customers system. Put each system's own containers in its own file, and keep the cross-system relationship in the root file. Run `structurizrx validate --strict` on the root file before you consider it done.
